summary: As transport protocol headers start to be encrypted, this informational document discusses the impact. Encryption helps avoid ossification by middleboxes, mitigates attacks and protects metadata, but networks that inspect transport headers for operations can no longer do so. The document suggests issues to consider when designing new transport protocols or features.

eli5.summary: If the labels on parcels are hidden, thieves cannot read them, but the delivery workers cannot either. This document discusses that trade-off for internet traffic.

questions: impact of quic header encryption on networks
